_comment: Tier-2 for kratos poisson: FALSIFIES the pre-2026-08-03 catalog claim 'Properties (CONDUCTIVITY, DENSITY, SPECIFIC_HEAT) go on Properties object, NOT on nodes'. On Kratos 10.4.0 LaplacianElement2D3N reads the diffusivity NODALLY via ConvectionDiffusionSettings.GetDiffusionVariable; the Properties value is ignored. Swap test reading LHS[0][0]: nodal 1 + Properties 1 -> 1.0; nodal 1 + Properties 999 -> 1.0; nodal 999 + Properties 1 -> 999.0. This also resolves a direct contradiction inside the catalog: KNOWLEDGE['curved_mms'] pitfall #1 said nodal (right), KNOWLEDGE['poisson'] said Properties (wrong). Verified by execution 2026-08-03.
